packageRules.description: Cargo dependencies are linked into the released binary, so a bump only reaches users through a release — build is in release_commits. Needed because :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers types lockfile-only updates as chore, and a patch-level security fix arrives lockfile-only — sibling repo colporteur stranded an ammonia XSS fix on master this way. Tooling, dev-dependencies and actions never reach the artifact and stay chore.

The docs site is a build directory, not part of the crate. config:recommended types npm `dependencies` updates as fix, and release-plz releases on ^(feat|fix|build) — so a Starlight bump would publish a crates.io version with no code change. Docs dependencies never reach the binary and stay chore.
